title: ESCRT-0 condensation and cargo clustering drive extracellular vesicle budding from cilia
title_zh: ESCRT-0 相分离及货物簇化驱动纤毛来源的细胞外囊泡出芽
abstract: Cilia-derived extracellular vesicles (EVs) mediate cell-cell communication and remove signaling molecules from cilia. The Hedgehog receptor Smoothened (SMO) is selected for packaging into ciliary EVs by ubiquitin chains, but how cargo selection is coupled to EV budding remains unknown. In this work, working in mouse kidney cells, we found that the ubiquitin reader endosomal sorting complex required for transport–0 (ESCRT-0) orchestrates both cargo selection and EV biogenesis. Unlike the conventional ESCRT pathway, SMO secretion did not require the ESCRT-III membrane scission machinery. Instead, ESCRT-0 condensed at the ciliary tip, where it clustered ubiquitinated SMO to drive EV biogenesis. Disrupting ESCRT-0 condensation blocked SMO secretion, and combining forced recruitment of ESCRT-0 with optogenetic clustering of SMO was sufficient to reconstitute EV budding. Thus, ESCRT-0 condensation and cargo clustering constitute a minimal module for ESCRT-III–independent reverse-topology budding.
abstract_zh: 纤毛来源的细胞外囊泡（EV）介导细胞间通讯，并从纤毛中清除信号分子。刺激平滑化蛋白（SMO）作为刺猬信号通路受体，可被泛素链选择性地包装入纤毛EV中，但货物选择如何与EV出芽耦合尚不明确。在本研究中，我们利用小鼠肾细胞发现，泛素识别蛋白内体运输所需复合物0（ESCRT-0）同时协调货物选择和EV生物发生。与常规ESCRT通路不同，SMO分泌不需要ESCRT-III膜剪切机制。相反，ESCRT-0在纤毛尖端发生相分离，在那里将泛素化的SMO聚集以驱动EV生物发生。破坏ESCRT-0相分离阻断了SMO分泌，而将ESCRT-0强制募集与SMO的光遗传聚集相结合足以重建EV出芽。因此，ESCRT-0相分离和货物聚集构成了ESCRT-III非依赖的反向拓扑出芽的最小模块。
